purpose: Original Core Keeper mod-cover illustrations, redesigned from visual study of official gameplay screenshots.
observed_features: Orthogonal overhead environments with small shaded humanoid sprites
Textured wood, irregular rock faces, layered foliage and grounded furniture
Warm localized torchlight, colored emissive objects and dark cave boundaries
Crisp source pixels enlarged with nearest-neighbor scaling
authorship: Original Pillow drawings and authored sprite grids. No screenshot pixels, extracted game sprites, or other mod artwork incorporated.
scope: 27 covers; preserve the readable descriptions. Golden Chance remains labeled WORK IN PROGRESS.
regenerate: Run each generator with Python + Pillow from any working directory. Each writes its assigned release PNGs.
publish: python release/workshop_artwork.py updates only existing item previews; --dry-run validates and stages without upload.
